testimonials.quote:
Zen BJJ and Fitness is an exceptional facility that caters to a wide range of fitness enthusiasts. The gym boasts a huge matted area perfect for grappling, making it an ideal spot for Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu practitioners.

The weight lifting area is very well-equipped, providing everything you need for a comprehensive strength training session. Additionally, there's a dedicated section for boxing and kickboxing, which is great for those looking to improve their striking skills.

The gym offers classes for both adults and kids, ensuring that everyone in the family can find a suitable program. The facility itself is spacious and well-ventilated, creating a comfortable environment for workouts.

Moreover, the changing rooms and sauna are excellent, adding a touch of luxury to your fitness routine.

A special mention goes to Eric, an amazing and open-minded instructor with tons of knowledge and experience. His guidance and expertise make a significant difference in the training experience.

Overall, Zen BJJ and Fitness is a top-notch gym that provides a well-rounded fitness experience.
testimonials.name: And Gru

testimonials.quote: The best gym in Chilliwack, and the only one offering complete martial arts training, provides high-quality grappling and striking training at the most reasonable prices for an MMA gym that I have experienced. Plus, you can use the sauna after training. The atmosphere is very friendly, and the coaches are very caring. I always attend the 6 am morning class. Many thanks to Coach Eric!
testimonials.name: Miro Igulada

testimonials.quote: The owner has quickly become our friend and we are super happy with the knowledge he and the other trainers give our children. The whole family goes. Great atmosphere!
testimonials.name: Terris Elkins

testimonials.quote:
From the moment you walk in, you can feel the professionalism and positive energy. The coaches are extremely knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in your progress, whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced fighter.

Training sessions are intense, well-structured, and focused on proper technique, not ego. The environment is welcoming, respectful, and motivating, with a strong sense of community that pushes everyone to improve.

You get high-level instruction in striking, grappling, and conditioning, all while staying safe and disciplined. If you're serious about learning MMA or any single art, building confidence, and getting in great shape, this gym delivers on every level. Highly recommended.
testimonials.name: Varinder Bajwa
